meta.title: Batch device inserts for device manager
meta.body_summary: Implement batch device processing in the device manager consumer to reduce excessive individual inserts, and extend the device processor with helper and batch methods.

perf_labels.notes: Single commit batching device inserts; self-reviewed 'lgtm' and merged in ~2 minutes despite go test failing; no perf benchmark.
